name: comp_id
description: Hash of the comp's core units and carries; stays the same across reruns while those do

name: label
description: Display name, e.g. 'Sniper Jinx': the most invested trait and the main carry

name: boards
description: Boards in the patch assigned to this comp

name: matches
description: Distinct matches with at least one such board

name: units
description: Units on at least 25% of the comp's boards, most common first

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: Share of the comp's boards that had the unit (0-1)

fields.name: avg_items
fields.description: Items held, averaged over the boards that had the unit

fields.name: avg_star
fields.description: Star level, averaged over the boards that had the unit

name: traits
description: Active traits on at least 25% of the comp's boards, most common first

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: Share of the comp's boards where the trait was active (0-1)

fields.name: avg_tier
fields.description: tier_current, averaged over the boards where it was active

name: carries
description: Units that usually hold 2 or more items, most itemized first

name: sample_size
description: Boards the clusters were fitted on; every board in the patch is then assigned to its nearest comp

name: category
description: 1_cost_reroll, 2_cost_reroll, 3_cost_reroll, fast_8 or fast_9, from the carries' costs and average star levels; NULL when no carry has a known cost
